notes.title: Donald Trump is visiting FLYVALNY 20!8
notes.content:
Good afternoon dear friends! ヽ(~_~(・_・ )ゝ

A terrible incident occurred the other day, namely, a shooting occurred during a speech by former US President Donald Trump to supporters in Pennsylvania. The footage showed how shots rang out during Trump's speech in the city of Butler, in which he commented on the presidency of Joe Biden. Then Trump grabbed his neck with his hand and hid behind the podium. The bodyguards shielded him.

After the shots died down, Trump was escorted off the stage by members of the US Secret Service. There are traces of blood on the ex-president's face.

Later, Donald Trump said that he was wounded in the ear as a result of the shooting, but he was "fine."

Donald Trump himself assured supporters that he did not intend to give up. His campaign headquarters said that the former president will take part in the Republican Party congress next week.

Because of these events, we decided to add in-game items with it to express support for Steam, and you, dear fans, were able to decorate your steam profile! Sam, you are our elephant, we are with you and for you!
